mapper.select: SELECT virtual_market.market_id, virtual_market.seller_id, virtual_market.seller_nickname, virtual_market.created_at, virtual_market.updated_at, virtual_market.item_count, virtual_market.rating, virtual_market.store_type, virtual_market.item_id, market_items.title, market_items.description, market_items.price, market_items.status FROM virtual_market INNER JOIN market_items ON virtual_market.item_id = market_items.item_id WHERE virtual_market.seller_id = #{user_id}

SELECT auction_wishlists.user_id, auction_wishlists.item_id, auction_wishlists.created_at, auction_items.seller_nickname, auction_items.title, auction_items.description, auction_items.start_price, auction_items.current_price, auction_items.end_time, auction_items.status, auction_items.seller_id FROM auction_wishlists INNER JOIN auction_items ON auction_wishlists.item_id = auction_items.item_id WHERE auction_wishlists.user_id = #{user_id}

SELECT market_wishlists.user_id, market_wishlists.item_id, market_wishlists.created_at,
market_items.title, market_items.description, market_items.price, market_items.status,
virtual_market.seller_id, virtual_market.seller_nickname, virtual_market.item_count, virtual_market.rating, virtual_market.store_type
FROM market_wishlists INNER JOIN market_items ON market_wishlists.item_id = market_items.item_id INNER JOIN virtual_market ON market_items.item_id = virtual_market.item_id WHERE market_wishlists.user_id = #{user_id}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM auction_wishlists WHERE user_id = #{user_id} AND wishlist_id = #{auction_id}
DELETE FROM market_wishlists WHERE user_id = #{user_id} AND wishlist_id = #{market_id}
